name: knowledge-compiler
description: Compile PDFs, slides, docs, and agent sessions into a local Open Knowledge Format (OKF v0.3) Markdown wiki with a 2D/3D WebGL graph and linter.
suggestedPrompts: Initialize an OKF v0.3 knowledge vault in ./vault and compile the current session into it
Ingest a PDF, slide deck, or markdown folder into my knowledge vault and update index.md
Audit my knowledge vault for broken wikilinks, frontmatter errors, and orphan notes
